description: Search Mereka's reviewed public knowledge (programmes and courses, corporate training and the AI Lab, the Mereka @ Publika space and its room prices, partnerships, how to contact the team) and return passages with titles, source URLs and as-of dates. Answers come from Mereka's AI front desk (Reka), which reads only public information. Questions can be in English, Bahasa Malaysia, Chinese or Tamil. Read-only.

area.description: Optional: the part of Mereka the question is about, to rank its pages first, such as space-publika, ai-lab, corporate or mta. Leave out when unsure.

limit.description: How many passages to return (default 5, at most 8).

query.description: What the person wants to know, in their own words and language (English, Bahasa Malaysia, Chinese, Tamil).

name: search_mereka
title: Search Mereka's public knowledge
